name: GPT-4.1
description: A three-model API family introduced together across capability, latency, and cost tiers.

name: Claude 5
description: The current Claude generation. Fable and Mythos share the same capabilities and specifications, but Fable is widely released while Mythos is restricted to approved customers. Opus is the tier Anthropic recommends for complex coding work that runs over many steps.

name: Claude 4.5
description: The 2025 Claude generation. Anthropic lists Sonnet 4.5 among legacy models while Haiku 4.5 is still documented as a current model.

name: Gemini 3
description: The current Gemini generation, spanning Pro, Flash, and Flash-Lite tiers across point releases that Google documents with individual release and shutdown dates.

name: Gemini 2.5
description: The preceding Gemini generation. Its stable Pro and Flash models remain generally available and share a single technical report.

name: Llama 4
description: Meta's natively multimodal generation, built on a mixture-of-experts architecture and released as downloadable weights under a community licence.

name: Llama 3
description: Meta's text-only generation, grouped under History in Meta's model collection. Llama 3.1 introduced the 405B size and a 128K context window.
